definition:
architecture-beta
  group store(cloud)[Store]
  service edge(internet)[Edge] in store
  service api(server)[API] in store
  service db(database)[Database] in store
  edge:R -- L:api
  api:R -- L:db

block-beta
  columns 3
  entry["Intake"]:3
  plan["Plan"] build["Build"] test["Test"]
  entry --> build
  plan --> build
  build --> test

C4Context
  title Delivery portal
  Person(sender, "Sender", "Creates shipments")
  System(portal, "Delivery portal", "Tracks shipments")
  System_Ext(courier, "Courier API", "Returns delivery updates")
  Rel(sender, portal, "Books shipment")
  Rel(portal, courier, "Gets status")

cynefin-beta
  title Release decisions
  complex
    "Test a new workflow"
  complicated
    "Investigate latency"
  clear
    "Rotate access keys"
  chaotic
    "Restore checkout"

eventmodeling
  tf 01 ui BookingScreen
  tf 02 cmd ReserveRoom
  tf 03 evt RoomReserved
  tf 04 rmo BookingSummary ->> 03

flowchart LR
  a([Open request]) --> b{Approved?}
  b -->|Yes| c[Schedule work]
  b -->|No| d[Revise request]

gantt
  title Release schedule
  dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
  axisFormat %b %d
  todayMarker off
  section Delivery
  Design :done, design, 2026-11-16, 2d
  Build :active, build, after design, 3d
  Verify :verify, after build, 2d

gitGraph
  commit id: "Base"
  branch release
  checkout release
  commit id: "Prepare"
  checkout main
  commit id: "Fix"
  merge release tag: "v1.0"

ishikawa-beta
  Late shipment
  Warehouse
    Missing stock
    Queue overload
  Courier
    Missed pickup
    Road closure

journey
  title Collect an order
  section Online
    Reserve: 5: Buyer
    Get a code: 4: Buyer, Store
  section In store
    Find locker: 3: Buyer
    Pick up order: 5: Buyer, Store

kanban
  backlog[Backlog]
    one[Review feedback]
    two[Update templates]
  active[In progress]
    three[Verify checkout]
  shipped[Done]
    four[Write release notes]

mindmap
  root((Release))
    Build
      Package assets
      Run checks
    Publish
      Tag version
      Share notes

packet-beta
  title Message header
  0-7: "Kind"
  8-15: "Flags"
  16-31: "Length"
  32-63: "Message ID"

pie showData
  title Booking channels
  "Web" : 55
  "Mobile" : 30
  "Desk" : 15

quadrantChart
  title Delivery priorities
  x-axis Low effort --> High effort
  y-axis Low impact --> High impact
  quadrant-1 Plan
  quadrant-2 Do first
  quadrant-3 Delegate
  quadrant-4 Defer
  Cache: [0.25, 0.85]
  Search: [0.68, 0.75]
  Cleanup: [0.31, 0.19]

radar-beta
  title Service quality
  axis s["Speed"], r["Reliability"], a["Accuracy"], u["Usability"], c["Coverage"]
  curve baseline["Baseline"]{70, 90, 60, 65, 55}
  curve next["Target"]{85, 94, 75, 82, 76}
  min 0
  max 100

sankey-beta
  Orders,Warehouse,70
  Orders,Store,30
  Warehouse,Courier,70
  Store,Pickup,30

sequenceDiagram
  participant B as Buyer
  participant A as Booking API
  participant D as Database
  B->>A: Reserve room
  A->>D: Save booking
  D-->>A: Booking ID
  A-->>B: Confirm reservation

stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Draft
  Draft --> Review: Submit
  Review --> Draft: Request changes
  Review --> Published: Approve
  Published --> [*]

swimlane-beta LR
  subgraph sender [Sender]
    open[Open request]
    send[Send details]
    open --> send
  end
  subgraph desk [Service desk]
    review[Review details]
    close[Close request]
    review --> close
  end
  send --> review

timeline

  section Preparation
    Nov 16 : Review scope : Assign owners
    Nov 17 : Finish tests
  section Release
